invariants.rationale: rollbackInstantTime is typically a required String identifier, most methods assume it is non-null.
commitInstant will be used to identify what needs to be rolled back, so it should be non-null.
context is required for distributed operations; a null value would likely raise an error.
rollbackInstantTime denotes an instant and such identifiers are not typically empty.
deleteInstants is a boolean and must be true or false; including to span both cases, but mainly to show it is always defined and no side effects.
